description: First wartime winter rains: intermittent rain and flooding damaged or destroyed IDP tents and makeshift shelters in the south; downpour, strong winds and flooding at a UNRWA school in Rafah (14 Nov).
notes: No counts ('damaged or destroyed tents and makeshifts', 'over the past 24 hours'); FU#40 (15 Nov) restates over 'past 48 hours'. Date evidence: Al Jazeera caption 13 Nov (Khan Younis tents); UNRWA SitRep #31-33 photo captions 14 Nov (Rafah school, Deir al Balah hospital tents); PRCS evacuation of Al Quds Hospital 'amid rain' 14 Nov (FU#40). The UNRWA caption is the only wind reference of the winter.

description: 'Thousands' of newly arrived IDPs sleeping in the open in the south exposed to heavy rain.
notes: Window derived from 'in the past 24 hours' (pub 20 Nov). Not quantified. WHO (FU#46, 21 Nov) refers to 'cold rain recently' raising epidemic risk (no count).

description: Rain accumulated 'in recent days' in the Sheikh Radwan stormwater/wastewater lagoon (Gaza City); Gaza Municipality warned of potential overflow flooding large areas.
notes: Warning only (Authority: Gaza Municipality via OCHA, 'reportedly'); no later flash update (#55-#150) confirms an overflow. Start date not stated ('recent days'); may be the same rain as GZ-2324-02.

description: Heavy rains flooded 'many of the areas' / 'large parts of Gaza', worsening sewage and solid-waste problems in IDP shelters.
notes: No counts. Restated in FU#69 (14 Dec) and UN News (14 Dec); UNRWA SitRep #53 photo caption (Deir al Balah tents, 13 Dec). Best-dated event of the winter. See GZ-2324-05 for the overlapping 'past week' reports.

description: Cold and rain flooded tents and makeshift shelters in Rafah 'over the past week'; UNICEF cites 'this week's rains and flooding' (20 Dec).
notes: Overlaps GZ-2324-04: FU#73's 'past week' (pub 19 Dec) almost certainly includes 13 Dec; UNICEF's 'this week' (Wed 20 Dec, ~17/18-20 Dec) may or may not be a second episode. Kept as a separate low-confidence row; do not double count with GZ-2324-04. No counts.

description: Heavy rainfall 'last week' flooded various locations including Jabalya camp, with sewage-contaminated floodwater (Jabalya flooding first reported 5 Jan).
exposure_note: At least 100,000 IDPs estimated in UN and public shelters in the flooded Jabalya area (OCHA FU#91, 12 Jan 2024) - exposure, not a count of people affected.
notes: Window derived from 'last week' (pub Tue 9 Jan). FU#85 (5 Jan) first reported the Jabalya flooding citing media and attributed it to the damaged Abu Rasheed pumping station and lagoon infiltration, not rain. No counts.

description: Flooding reported across parts of the Strip 'due to winter weather', infrastructure damage and clogged sewage; several rainwater lagoons at risk of flooding if rain intensifies.
notes: Undated ('is being reported', FU#93 15 Jan and FU#94 16 Jan); 'due to winter weather' appears only in #94. May be a continuation of GZ-2324-06. No counts.

description: Overnight torrential rain flooded tents in Deir al Balah, washing away mattresses, food and clothes; Rafah tents flooded ('unknown number'); IMS reported a 5-8 C temperature drop.
notes: Date from CNN ('overnight Wednesday' 24->25 Jan). UN: OCHA FU#104 (28 Jan) relays UNRWA - 'an unknown number of tents ... in Rafah were flooded', 'thousands of families ... freezing' - undated, assumed to be the same system. Wind implied by residents ('All the nylon flew away'). CNN's '~100 mm January average' sentence is unattributed. No counts.

description: Area around Pumping Station 7B 'currently inundated' with sewage-contaminated floodwater; residents in contact with floodwater in the streets.
notes: Not explicitly rain-attributed; undated; governorate not stated. Repeated FU#112-115 (to 9 Feb). UNRWA SitRep #74 caption: 'rainy and cold day', Feb 2024. Only Feb 2024 flood item found; no weather impacts found for Mar 2024.

description: First winter storm: heavy rain plus high tides flooded coastal tents (Al Mawasi overnight 25 Nov; Al Qarara seaport, Khan Younis) and destroyed shelters at Deir al Balah sites.
hh_affected_scope: SW Gaza shoreline only; approximate ('~7,000 families'); preliminary partner assessments
exposure_note: Over 1.6 million people in makeshift shelters, 'nearly half a million' in flood-prone areas (OCHA HSU#241); SMWG: 101 flood-prone sites hosting 450,720 people (12 Nov 2024).
notes: hh: ~7,000 shoreline families 'affected' ('preliminary assessments by humanitarian partners'; UNRWA SitRep #149 repeats). tents_damaged_un = 60 destroyed + 120 damaged shelters at 2 of 19 Deir al Balah sites run by one partner (same sentence) - partial. NOT added: >600 tents 'reported to have been flooded' by high tides at Al Qarara seaport (OCHA, reporter unnamed; flooded is not necessarily damaged; different location). tents_authority = GMO estimate of ~10,000 tents 'washed away or damaged' (statement 25 Nov, via OCHA). Rain date: PCD reported damage 24 Nov; OCHA says heavy rain 25 Nov; SMWG (GHRU 10 Dec) dates it 24 Nov. IRC (5 Dec, undated, probably this storm): 40% of tents destroyed at Asdaa camp, 45% at Ard Fayyad (NGO, community leaders). Shelter Cluster (16 Dec): late-Nov storm destroyed tents and forced relocations (no count). No building collapses reported.

description: High tides / sea surge along the Khan Younis-Rafah coast after the storm; UNOSAT mapped the highest observed watermark on 30 Nov.
exposure_note: A further 8,329 IDP shelters in the UNOSAT risk zone ('not observed in impact').
notes: 528 = UNOSAT category 'directly affected or located in an extremely hazardous zone' (imagery 30 Nov Pleiades and 1 Dec WorldView-2; preliminary, not field-validated) - an upper bound on directly affected shelters. Reflects conditions on 30 Nov-1 Dec and may include damage from GZ-2425-01. OCHA HSU#243 (3 Dec): 'high tides had displaced many families in recent days'. Start = GLIDE date (26 Nov); no source gives the surge days.

description: Cold nights: newborn and adult hypothermia deaths in tents in Al Mawasi (Khan Younis) and Deir al Balah; AP reported 9 C on the night of 24-25 Dec.
deaths_source: cold: Authority - MoH via OCHA HSU#251: at least 5 newborns (3 days-1 month) died of hypothermia 24-29 Dec, plus 1 adult medical worker reported 27 Dec.
notes: Newborn count is 'at least five'. Media via OCHA: 3 babies died 24-26 Dec in Al Mawasi tents; a 20-day-old in Deir al Balah the night of 28 Dec (France24: found 29 Dec). UNICEF 26 Dec (MoH): 4 newborns/infants 'in recent days'. UNRWA SitRep #153 duplicates. Running totals (>=7 in December; 8 by 6 Jan) are in gaza_season_totals.csv - not summed here.

description: Heavy rain flooded shelters in Gaza City, Al Mawasi (Khan Younis), western Deir al Balah and Rafah; hundreds of distress calls 28-30 Dec.
notes: No UN count. tents_authority = 1,542 tents flooded on 30 and 31 Dec in Gaza, Khan Younis, Deir al Balah and Rafah governorates (PCD via OCHA; flooded, not necessarily damaged). PCD 'hundreds' of distress calls 28-30 Dec (HSU#251). IOM (3 Jan): rains 'overwhelmed displacement sites' (no count). Sheikh Radwan lagoon still could not be drained (GHRU 22 Dec-4 Jan).

description: Further infant hypothermia death (35-day-old) announced by MoH on 6 Jan; MoH hypothermia total reaches 8.
deaths_source: cold: Authority - MoH via OCHA HSU#253.
notes: Death date not stated (announced 6 Jan). MoH total of 8 by 6 Jan (age mix unstated; may include the adult in GZ-2425-03) implies one further death between 29 Dec and 6 Jan that no source dates - not assigned to any event.

description: Heavy rain and strong winds during the ceasefire: tents destroyed in Deir al Balah and North Gaza; 5 child-friendly spaces and the largest women-and-girls safe space destroyed; learning spaces damaged.
hh_affected_scope: 23 of 1,328 sites assessed 6-9 Feb (SMC partners) - partial floor ('at least 800')
notes: 800 = families reporting damage to shelters, tents, water tanks and latrines at 23 assessed sites. UNRWA via OCHA: 'hundreds of families' affected, 'hundreds of tents destroyed', several households displaced (no count). Education Cluster: several TLSs damaged 5-6 Feb, >500 students' learning suspended (GHRU 2-15 Feb). Gaza City Municipality via Al Jazeera: sewage and rainwater entered 'hundreds' of tents (Authority via media).

description: Cold: six newborns died of cold/hypothermia (5 at Patient's Friends Hospital, Gaza City; 1 two-month-old in an Al Mawasi tent).
deaths_source: cold: hospital directors / health officials cited in media, via OCHA HSU#267 - not MoH-confirmed, not UN-verified.
notes: Repeated by UNRWA SitRep #161 and UNICEF SitRep 36 (which conflicts internally on location). No weather impacts found for March 2025.

description: First winter rains (14-15 Nov) flooded thousands of tents, especially in Gaza City and the north; sea encroached on shoreline tents and winds collapsed tents in Khan Younis/Mawasi (16-17 Nov); Sheikh Radwan basin rose 37 cm.
hh_affected_scope: Strip-wide (OCHA, no named source); lower bound ('more than')
exposure_note: SMC: 'affected more than 740,000 people across 715 displacement sites, including 384 in high flood-risk areas' (HSU#342) - population of sites in affected areas (~55x the household count), treated as exposure. >4,000 households sheltering along the Khan Younis shoreline (SMC, SR25).
notes: hh: OCHA SR22 (15 Nov) 'more than 13,000 households were affected by rain'; SR23 (17 Nov) 'over 13,000 families'. tents: Shelter Cluster via HSU#342, 'an estimated 13,000 tents completely damaged' (14-15 Nov); 'completely damaged' is not split into destroyed, so tents_destroyed_un left empty. The same 13,000 appears as households (OCHA) and tents (SC): possible conflation. NOT used (subset): one SMC partner's '~12,000 families in 29 makeshift sites' (SR25). Education: 38 TLSs damaged (~9,528 students; 103 tents, 10 latrines; HSU#344). Sea encroachment and wind tent collapses: SMC preliminary findings 16-17 Nov (SR25), no count. HSU#344 mentions a '17 November rainstorm' (no separate figures). Cumulative SMC pre-Byron figures (65,745 people/141 sites by 5 Dec; >140,000 IDPs/219 sites by ~8 Dec) span this event, GZ-2526-02 and GZ-2526-03 - see season totals. Rain: 12-23 mm at Israeli stations near the border 13-16 Nov (Times of Israel). GLIDE FL-2025-000224-PSE.

description: Rain and flooding in designated emergency shelters (DESs).
hh_affected_scope: 32 DESs only (SMC rapid assessments); makeshift sites not counted; lower bound
notes: 'More than 3,000 people were affected': 25 North Gaza, 205 Gaza City, 1,333 Deir al Balah, 1,438 Khan Younis (sum 3,001). One TLS in Deir al Balah (5,773 students) affected on 25 Nov (SR32).

description: Severe flooding at eight displacement sites in Khan Younis; ~75% of these sites lost functional latrines to rising floodwater.
exposure_note: >10,000 people 'currently sheltering' in the 8 flooded sites (OCHA SR41) - population of affected sites, not a count of people directly affected.
notes: The cumulative SMC figure as of ~8 Dec (219 sites flooded, >140,000 IDPs directly impacted; SR42) includes this event - see season totals. >3,500 displacement movements on 7-8 Dec in anticipation of Storm Byron (SR42).

description: Storm Byron: rain peaks 10-11 and 15-16 Dec, strong winds 13-14 Dec, coastal flooding of shoreline sites (10 Dec); war-damaged buildings collapsed (11-12 and 15-16 Dec, continuing to 20-21 Dec); infant hypothermia deaths.
hh_affected_scope: Strip-wide SMC flood-alert count as of 16 Dec ('nearly'); SMC says impact likely significantly higher
deaths_source: UN - Health Cluster: 'confirmed' 12 storm-related deaths (11 building/wall collapse, 1 hypothermia) as of 17 Dec (SR49), plus a second hypothermia death (one-month-old) reported 18 Dec (SR50). Authority alternatives in notes.
exposure_note: SMC pre-winter mapping: ~795,000 people (first given as 849,977) in 761 flood-prone sites; >180,000 people in >200 sites prioritized for evacuation (SR42, HSU#347, HSU#353). IOM: Byron put 'nearly 795,000' at heightened risk.
notes: people/tents/sites: Shelter Cluster via HSU#349, cumulative since 10 Dec as of ~17 Dec - >42,000 tents or makeshift shelters with full or partial damage in 320 displacement sites and 43 areas (sites_affected_un excludes the 43 areas), at least 235,000 people, 17 buildings collapsed. hh: SMC 'nearly 55,000 households' across 132 sites (HSU#349); SR49 gives 'nearly 55,000 families ... across 411 sites' (OCHA estimate) and lists 132 as flood incidents (Khan Younis highest) vs HSU#349's 132 sites (Gaza City highest) - unresolved. Daily SMC figures subsumed (do not add): 10 Dec >=465 hh/2,731 people/260 tents (SR44); 11 Dec 161 alerts, >16,000 families assessed, 360 hh/>1,800 people in 18 sites (SR44/45); as of 14 Dec 61 sites/~30,000 people (SR47); 13-14 Dec wind: 32 tents destroyed, torn tents for 39 families, 16 families displaced (SR47); 15-16 Dec 44 DESs, 4,721 people, >691 tents (SR48); 22 sites/821 families left with no shelter (SR49); >=370 families evacuated from the shoreline (HSU#349). Deaths, Authority: MoH 12 collapse + 1 hypothermia (2-week-old, 15 Dec) as of 17 Dec (HSU#349); PCD 18 deaths in 22 buildings collapsed after the 10 Dec storm, as of 21 Dec (SR53), including lagged collapses 18-21 Dec (SR52/53). MSF: 29-day-old died 18 Dec at Nasser (cause not stated; possibly the SR50 case). NOT used: UNRWA snippet '>=16 deaths' (unverified); 'at least 14 killed' (not on UN pages). PCD: >5,000 distress calls, 17 buildings collapsed, >90 precariously damaged by 17 Dec. tents_authority = GMO 27,000 tents 'flooded or swept away' (Al Jazeera 15 Dec, as of ~14-15 Dec). EM-DAT 2025 'storm' (oPt) 235,020 affected / 18 deaths - almost certainly Byron. SR56's 56,051 families 'since 11 Dec' (as of ~28 Dec) also covers GZ-2526-05 - see season totals. Rain (Israeli stations, outside Gaza): 60-160 mm in week to ~17 Dec (IMS via Gulf News).

description: Late-December rainstorm: seawater again inundated tents in Al Mawasi (Khan Younis), heavy winds destroyed or damaged numerous tents, war-damaged buildings collapsed; Sheikh Radwan lagoon rose from 1.8 to 2.2 m.
deaths_source: collapse: woman (30) killed by a wall collapse - Authority (PCD via OCHA HSU#351); other: child (7) drowned in a well / flooded improvised site - Authority (PCD via HSU#351), also OCHA SR60 (no named source, dated 27 Dec); cold: two-month-old died 29 Dec - Authority (MoH via HSU#351).
notes: No UN household or tent count for this event alone. Education: >=5 TLSs (~1,460 learners) and 23 TLS tents damaged ~28-29 Dec (SR57); 787 tents distributed to families with damaged shelters (SR57, response). SR58 (3 Jan): 'recent rains' raised Wadi Gaza and Sheikh Radwan levels (~30 Dec-2 Jan); SR60 names 30 Dec as a storm/flood date. Cumulative figures spanning Byron and this event (not assigned here): SC December snapshot 65,000 families/537 sites; SR56 56,051 families since 11 Dec - see season totals. The 1,792 families given tents on 3-4 Jan (GZ-2526-06) may relate to this storm. 'Once again' implies earlier surge episodes (16-17 Nov, 10 Dec).

description: Joint response to 'rainstorm incidents': 1,792 families given tents during 3-4 Jan; the rain date is not stated.
hh_affected_scope: response count: families given tents in the intersectoral joint storm response, 3-4 Jan; rain date not stated
source_publisher: OCHA SR No. 59 (Shelter Cluster joint response)
notes: Window is the distribution window, not the rain date (SR59 data as of 5 Jan). SR60 names 'winter storms and consequent flooding on 30 December and on 9 January'; SR58 reports rains to ~2 Jan - the families most likely date from GZ-2526-05 / 30 Dec. Not added to GZ-2526-05. Separate and not weather-attributed by the source: 5 Jan four-storey building collapse in Al Maghazi camp killed 2 and injured 5 (PCD via HSU#353) - not counted.

description: Heavy rains in northern Gaza destroyed the shelters of more than 1,300 households at 34 sites.
hh_affected_scope: 34 sites in northern Gaza (SMC urgent alerts); lower bound
notes: The households' shelters were destroyed but no shelter count is given, so tent columns are empty. SR60 names 9 Jan as a storm/flood date.

description: Severe storm from the evening of 12 Jan: strong winds, heavy rain, flooding and cold; tents blown off, a shelter structure collapsed, child cold deaths; 86% of incidents recorded after 13 Jan.
hh_affected_scope: 106 sites (SMC, 12-15 Jan); SMC later reported ~4,000 more households at 89 further sites - in notes, not added
deaths_source: UN-relayed - SMC partners via OCHA SR61 (as of 13 Jan): 3 children died of extreme cold (Khan Younis, Gaza City); 3 people killed when their shelter structure collapsed (Al Shati). SR62 reports 7 fatalities at the 106 sites with no cause split (1 cause unknown).
notes: Columns are SR62's coherent set: 4,136 hh (~19,230 people), 106 sites, 3,455 tents and makeshift shelters destroyed or severely damaged, 34 injuries, >=287 newly displaced, 253 WASH facilities non-functional. Increment NOT added: SR63 (20 Jan, SMC winter alert dashboard) - an additional 89 sites affected 12-16 Jan, ~4,000 households (~17,000 people), ~1,400 displaced from Khan Younis to Gaza City; no tent count. Superseded early count: SR61 (13 Jan) 597 tents blown off or heavily damaged, >3,000 people, 47 injuries, 6 fatalities, 18 distress calls. Response: 1,370 households given tents (SR62); 661 households (SR63). MoH: 7 child hypothermia deaths by 14 Jan (4 since 1 Jan) and 31 storm-related deaths season-to-date - see season totals. UNICEF (13 Jan): '30, 40-km/h winds ripping through tents on the beach'. SC January snapshot (17,221 families/154 sites) covers all of January - season totals.

description: Cold spell with strong winds: two infants died of cold 17-20 Jan; wind damaged temporary structures, shattered windows and broke doors, mostly in DESs in Deir al Balah and Khan Younis (19-21 Jan).
hh_affected_scope: 18 SMC weather-damage alerts, mostly DESs (19-21 Jan); figure possibly carried over from SR61 - see notes
deaths_source: cold: Authority - MoH via OCHA SR63: a 27-day-old and a six-month-old died of cold 17-20 Jan (total child cold deaths 9).
exposure_note: 4 high-risk makeshift sites on coastal cliffs in Deir al Balah: 931 households at risk of cliff collapse, erosion and storm-driven wave surge (SMC partner rapid assessment, SR64).
notes: Caution: '~3,000 people (597 households)' and '18 alerts' repeat SR61's 12-13 Jan numbers ('597 tents', '>3,000 people', '18 distress calls'), although SR64's context (DESs, broken windows and doors) differs - possibly a carried-over figure; checked on the ochaopt.org page. UN Spokesperson (22 Jan): a 3-month-old 'found frozen to death' on 'Tuesday' (20 Jan), total 9 - probably one of the two MoH deaths (ages differ). 'Documented fatalities' at Shat Al-Tal from a recent landslide (no count, undated). PCD warned on 22 Jan of further collapses.

description: Heavy-rainfall response week: 772 households affected by heavy rainfall assisted; one new weather alert (61 families, Az-Zaytoun, Gaza City).
hh_affected_scope: response count: households assisted in the joint storm response during 22-28 Jan; rain date not stated
exposure_note: ~1,000 Khan Younis shoreline households targeted for last-resort relocation due to direct exposure to high tides and coastal flooding (SR65).
source_publisher: OCHA SR No. 65 (Shelter Cluster storm response)
notes: Window = response/reporting week, not the rain date. SR65 also says 566 families 'identified during the previous week' (i.e. hit by GZ-2526-08/09) received packages 22-28 Jan, so the 772 may partly reflect earlier storms. The only alert clearly inside the window: 61 families in Az-Zaytoun. Cold: WHO (27 Jan) 10 child hypothermia deaths, then MoH 11 (up from 9 on 20 Jan) - deaths not individually dated, not assigned to this row.

description: Response week: 367 families affected by flooding and heavy rains assisted (Gaza City, Deir al Balah, Mawasi).
hh_affected_scope: response count: families affected by flooding and heavy rains among 455 assisted 29 Jan-4 Feb; rain date not stated
notes: Window = assistance window. SR66: '455 displaced families ... received multisectoral assistance packages ... The remaining 367 families were affected by flooding and heavy rains.'

description: Response week: 289 displaced families in Deir al Balah and Khan Younis whose shelters and belongings were damaged by heavy rains assisted.
hh_affected_scope: response count: families assisted 5-11 Feb; rain date not stated
notes: Window = assistance window. Post-distribution monitoring in Gaza City: 96% of 540 surveyed households (of 3,984 supported) got help within 48 h; only 48% rated tents effective in heavy rain.

description: Response: 582 households 'mainly affected by rains' supported on 15 Feb (plus 6 households on 14 Feb affected by flooding 'during the last rains' and by fires).
hh_affected_scope: response count: households supported on 15 Feb; rain date not stated ('the last rains')
notes: 14-15 Feb are distribution dates. 'The last rains' is undated and may be the same rain as GZ-2526-12 - possible double counting with the 289. The 6 households of 14 Feb (mixed flood/fire) are excluded.

description: Rainstorm struck Gaza 23-24 Feb; multisectoral assistance to affected families began 25 Feb.
hh_affected_scope: families receiving packages (distribution began 25 Feb); lower bound ('over 240')
exposure_note: SMC site review (~900 sites): ~606 sites (64%) report rainwater accumulation (SR69).
notes: Only post-January response count whose rain date is stated by the source. Still a response count, not an assessed total.

description: Response week: 253 families affected by rains assisted (northern Gaza, Deir al Balah, Khan Younis).
hh_affected_scope: response count: families affected by rains assisted 26 Feb-4 Mar; rain date not stated
notes: Window = assistance window. A further 10 families affected by accidental fires are excluded.

description: Severe sandstorm with strong winds, followed by rain: extensive damage to lightweight temporary shelters and site infrastructure.
notes: '29 family shelters destroyed and 32 damaged' - tents_damaged_un = 29 + 32 from the same sentence. Also damaged several education, nutrition and child-protection facilities; >=1 TLS (~850 learners) damaged (HSR 27 Mar). Mainly wind/dust (no hazard code for sand). IDMC IDU: 29 households / 147 people displaced (147 is not on the OCHA page; IDMC-derived).

description: Rainstorms (reported together with fire incidents) affected households in displacement sites.
hh_affected_scope: mixed causes: rainstorms and fire incidents; rain share not stated
notes: HSR 2 Apr restates as 'over 100 other households affected by rainstorms and fire incidents between 16 and 22 March'. Response: packages to 51 households, tarpaulins to 16.

description: Heavy rains flooded or damaged the tents and belongings of displaced people across Gaza.
notes: people: 'more than 3,000 displaced people'. Response: 373 households supported via the Rapid Joint Distribution Mechanism, ~350 full packages and ~380 tarpaulin households planned. NOT used (mixed cause): SMC 23-29 Mar aggregate - 78 alerts, 96% linked to severe wind and rain, rest fire/conflict - 2,396 families (~11,634 people), 731 shelters destroyed, 1,582 damaged, 17 injuries, 9 fatalities. Education: flash floods 23-30 Mar damaged >=15 TLSs (~20,000 students).

description: Storm (just outside the Nov-Mar window): shelters destroyed or damaged; SMC received urgent requests for >100 tents and 460 tarpaulins.
notes: No affected count. The 1,393 households supported 30 Mar-5 Apr through the Rapid Joint Distribution Mechanism (families who lost shelter or belongings to adverse weather) overlap the 25-26 Mar response (HSR 2 Apr planned ~1,100), so they are not used as an impact count. Described as 'the storm'; families 'affected by rainfall' - wind not stated. Boundary event.
